description: Test suite for the questions feature in a React application, utilizing React Testing Library and mocking various service modules to verify UI interactions, data fetching, and CRUD operations related to questions and answers.

methods.name: list page loads results and paginates, updates URL on search
methods.description: Tests that the questions list page loads with results, supports pagination, and updates URL when the user performs a search.

methods.name: ask question requires title and content, preview toggles, and submit calls service
methods.description: Verifies that the question asking form requires title and content, allows toggling a preview mode, and submits data successfully.

methods.name: edit question loads data, saves and deletes
methods.description: Checks that editing a question fetches existing data, updates it, and can delete the question.

methods.name: question detail shows answers and allows posting new answer
methods.description: Ensures question detail page displays answers and enables posting new answers.

methods.name: drafts lists items
methods.description: Tests that draft items are listed correctly, including untitled drafts.
